title: Some Desperate Glory
author: Emily Tesh
summary: Kyr has been raised on a space station by the last survivors of Earth's destruction, taught to avenge it. When she leaves the only home she knows, she finds that what she was taught does not hold up.
readIf: you like intense, character-driven space opera about radicalisation and growing out of it.
skipIf: you want a light read, as it includes brutal violence and a bleak start.
